icons.prompt: Create ONE square World of Warcraft-style hand-painted fantasy MMORPG ability icon. This belongs to one coherent six-icon family. Full-bleed opaque dark painted background, square corners, no outer frame, no text, no letters, no watermark, not a logo or polished metal emblem. Classic Warcraft chunky expressive character anatomy, strong painterly brushwork, dramatic magical light, deep shadows, rich colors, simple bold masses, restrained details. Must be instantly readable at 60x60 pixels: enormous main subject, clear silhouette and face, almost no scenery. Do not make a photorealistic or 3D-rendered image. Attack mode AUTO: a watchful green orc monster head, alert yellow eyes, small tusks, facing forward with a serious ready-for-combat expression. Clearly visible GOLDEN circular cycling arrows surround its head, two broad curved gold arrows with obvious arrowheads. Arrows must be gold, not green. Dark forest-green background. Keep the eyes and face unobscured. This is a calm alert automatic-target-selection icon.
